places.name: Othello Castle (Citadel)
places.ai_summary: Othello Castle is a historic fortress in Famagusta, known for its Venetian architecture and connection to Shakespeare's play.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Explore the ramparts for panoramic views of the city.

attribution.title: The Ramparts, Famagusta
attribution.author: Richard
attribution.credit: originally posted to Flickr as The Ramparts, Famagusta, Northern Cyprus
attribution.description: This is an archive photo I took on holiday  4 or 5 years ago in Northern Cyprus. I was prompted to include this shot having recently seen a very beautiful series of photos taken on and near the ramparts by my fellow Flickr photographer friend, Armagan. My photo is more pedestrian and touristic but I was very fascinated by the city and its culture.

places.name: Salamis Ancient Ruins
places.ai_summary: The Salamis Ancient Ruins are a sprawling archaeological site featuring Roman baths, a gymnasium, and a theater.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning to avoid the heat.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking on uneven terrain.

places.name: Lala Mustafa Pasha Mosque (St. Nicholas Cathedral)
places.ai_summary: This mosque, originally a Gothic cathedral, is a stunning example of medieval architecture with intricate stone carvings.

opening_hours.notes: Closed during prayer times.

places.place_tip: Admire the blend of Gothic and Ottoman architectural styles.
places.address: Lala Mustafa Pasha Mosque, Famagusta, Cyprus

places.name: Ghost Town of Varosha
places.ai_summary: Varosha is a ghost town in Famagusta, abandoned since the Turkish invasion of Cyprus in 1974, and now a fenced-off area.

opening_hours.notes: Access is restricted and guided tours are mandatory.

places.place_tip: Visit the Varosha Beach for a view of the abandoned city.
places.address: Ghost Town of Varosha, Famagusta, Cyprus

places.name: Famagusta City Walls
places.ai_summary: The Famagusta City Walls are well-preserved medieval fortifications that offer panoramic views of the city and the sea.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the late afternoon or early evening.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the view from the Ramparts.

places.name: Sea Gate & Martinengo Bastion
places.ai_summary: The Sea Gate is an impressive example of Venetian military architecture, part of the Famagusta City Walls.

opening_hours.notes: Part of the city walls, access may be restricted.

places.place_tip: Check out the view of the harbor from the bastion.

places.name: Palm Beach
places.ai_summary: Palm Beach is a popular sandy beach in Famagusta, known for its clear waters and palm tree-lined promenade.

opening_hours.notes: Sunbeds and umbrellas are available for rent.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a walk on the promenade and try local snacks from nearby vendors.

places.name: Namık Kemal Dungeon Museum
places.ai_summary: This museum, located in a former prison, showcases the life and works of the Turkish Cypriot poet Namık Kemal.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a tour of the old town.
places.address: Namık Kemal Dungeon Museum, Famagusta, Cyprus

places.name: Kantara Castle (Five Finger Mountains)
places.ai_summary: Kantara Castle is a Byzantine castle located on the Kantara mountain range, offering stunning views of the surrounding area.

opening_hours.notes: Access may be restricted during bad weather.

places.place_tip: Bring water and wear sturdy shoes for the hike up to the castle.

places.name: St. Barnabas Monastery & Icon Museum
places.ai_summary: This monastery is dedicated to St. Barnabas, the patron saint of Cyprus, and features a museum with a collection of icons.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Visit the museum to learn about the history of Cyprus and the life of St. Barnabas.

places.name: Ayia Trias Basilica (Carpasia)
places.ai_summary: The Ayia Trias Basilica is an ancient basilica located in the Carpasia region, known for its impressive mosaics.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the cooler months.

places.place_tip: Bring a hat and water, as there is limited shade at the site.

places.name: Glapsides Beach
places.ai_summary: Glapsides Beach is a beautiful sandy beach located near Famagusta, popular for its clear waters and water sports.

opening_hours.notes: Sunbeds and umbrellas are available for rent.

places.place_tip: Try the local tavernas for fresh seafood.

places.name: Ancient Theater of Salamis
places.ai_summary: The Ancient Theater of Salamis is a well-preserved Roman theater, still used for performances today.

opening_hours.notes: Check schedule for performance dates.

places.place_tip: Bring a blanket or towel for seating during performances.
places.address: Ancient Theater of Salamis, Famagusta, Cyprus

places.name: Famagusta Old Town Stroll
places.ai_summary: A stroll through Famagusta's Old Town offers a glimpse into the city's rich history and diverse architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot, wear comfortable shoes.

places.place_tip: Stop by local cafes for a taste of traditional Cypriot coffee.

places.name: Sinan Pasha Mosque
places.ai_summary: Sinan Pasha Mosque is a historic mosque in Famagusta, known for its impressive architecture and serene courtyard.

opening_hours.notes: Closed during prayer times.

places.place_tip: Respect the dress code and silence inside the mosque.

places.name: Dr. Fazıl Küçük Museum
places.ai_summary: This museum is dedicated to the memory of Dr. Fazıl Küçük, a prominent Turkish Cypriot leader, and offers insights into his life and work.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a tour of the old town.
places.address: Dr. Fazıl Küçük Museum, Famagusta, Cyprus

places.name: Harbor Promenade Walk
places.ai_summary: A walk along the harbor promenade offers beautiful views of the sea and the city, especially at sunset.

opening_hours.notes: Best time to visit is during the evening for sunset views.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a meal or drink at one of the waterfront restaurants.

places.name: Varosha Beachfront
places.ai_summary: The Varosha Beachfront offers a unique view of the abandoned city of Varosha and is a popular spot for photography.

opening_hours.notes: Access to the beach is free, but the area is not developed.

places.place_tip: Bring your camera for stunning photos of the beachfront and the ghost town.

places.name: Cultural Heritage Center
places.ai_summary: The Cultural Heritage Center in Famagusta offers insights into the rich cultural history of the region through various exhibits and artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Check for any cultural events or exhibitions during your visit.

places.name: Salamis Forest Nature Trail
places.ai_summary: This nature trail in the Salamis Forest offers a peaceful hike with opportunities to see local flora and fauna.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the cooler parts of the day.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for bird watching and a camera for the scenic views.
places.address: Salamis Forest Nature Trail, Famagusta, Cyprus
